# colima-host

A Colima VM on the operator's machine, started by `cata` when it is not running.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| profile | string | `"catallaxy"` | The Colima profile to run on.  Shared by every lab that names it, so the default is one VM per operator rather than one per lab.  |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| host | [CONTAINER_HOST](../signatures/CONTAINER_HOST.md) | A docker engine the lab places clusters and host services on, as `cata` reaches it. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `every-floe` as the lab unit `host`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.
